answers.core: I think since the functionality already exists, exposing it for users to call from GDscript via editor plugin is a net-positive for flexibility in godot plugins.
answers.workaround: I do not think this can be worked around in script. I found a thread where the author was having difficult doing the same thing, leading me to dig into the source code and expose the bindings myself.  https://www.reddit.com/r/godot/comments/1g1d4uv/center_scene_editor_camera_viewport_to_node_from/

title: Expose "focus_selection" to GDScript so users can focus a selected node (or Vector) via script instead of pressing "F"
